messages:
Maria: Kicking off EU->APAC fanout priming tonight at 22:00 UTC. Short plan below — 1% canary -> stepped fanout -> promote. @Sam you on deploy? :rocket:
Sam: Yep, I got this. Window 22:00-22:15 UTC. Following the stepped fanout curve (1% -> 8% -> 30% -> 100%), 5m observation between steps. I’ll post live updates.
Priya: Routing updates are staged and tested in staging. Verified pathing with a few probes: `curl -sS -H "x-region: eu" https://edge-check.redwood.prod/health | jq .route` returned expected eu-backend.
Omar: Smoke checklist (quick):
- 95p latency < 120ms on eu-edge probes
- errors < 0.1%
- KV cache hit rate not regressing (>60%)
- fallback model/pool configured (na-fallback)
Please confirm monitors are enabled.
Li: DNS TTL set to 30s for the rollout window. I’ll revert to 5m after we hit stable 100% and keep a 30m watch. Also bumped healthprobe frequency to 30s for the window.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Sam at 22:00 UTC. Canary plan: 1% (5m) -> 8% (5m) -> 30% (10m) -> 100% (10m). Auto-rollback if error rate > 0.5% or latency spike > 2x baseline.
Sam: Starting at T+0 now. First canary at 1% applied. Monitoring dashboards pinned in #eng-platform: model-level latency, route-errors, kv-hit.
Priya: Quick smoke script (run from jumpbox):
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H "x-test: fanout" "https://edge-check.redwood.prod/health?region=apac" | jq -r .status; sleep 1; done
```
Omar: Watching metrics — 1% looks clean so far. 95p latency ~88ms, errors steady at 0.02%. KV hit 64%. :thumbsup:
Sam: Moving to 8% now. Will wait full 5m and post numbers. If anything odd I’ll hit rollback: `redwoodctl routing promote --to previous` (rollback command ready).
Priya: Heads-up: I validated the DNS glue for apac-edge; propagation looks ok for 30s TTL.
Maria: No objections from my side. If you see any small blips keep to the pause-and-observe cadence — don’t blast to 100% early. Ping when at 30% and again on 100%.
Sam: 8% steady. 5m hold completed. Proceeding to 30% now. Stats in 6m.
deploy-bot: Canary update: 8% succeeded. Next step 30% scheduled.
Omar: I’ll be around for the next 20m in case we need to revert. Oncall standby: @oncall.
Sam: 30% live. Initial telemetry: 95p 92ms, errors 0.03%, avg throughput healthy. Proceeding to 100% after 10m observation.
Li: Reminder: after stable 100% I’ll change TTL back to 5m and revert probe frequency.
Maria: Great work team — thanks. Please post final confirmation once 100% is stable and you’ve reverted TTL. :tada:
